games.name: [EARLY PAID ACCESS] Havoc
games.desc:
Sale is live. The game is 250 R$ and the sale ends in Oct 15.

Havoc immerses players in the aftermath of The Silence, a world where factions fight for survival and territory.

This is a hardcore extraction shooter built around real risk and consequence. It is loud, punishing, and unforgiving. Headphones are strongly recommended to hear threats early, as success depends entirely on your skill.

Havoc is currently available as paid access. Purchasing grants immediate access to the current build and all future updates.

>> The game runs on seasonal wipes. Gear, stash, and progress reset each season, but your profile and cosmetics are permanent.

Keybinds can be viewed in the Settings menu but cannot be changed at the moment.

>> The game is available on Console and PC. Controllers are not supported; mouse and keyboard are required.
